items.meaning: A member sees the season rehearsal calendar and marks attendance for each rehearsal.
Attendance for a rehearsal is known by the Monday before.
When a member misses three rehearsals in a row before a concert, the section leader is told so a person can call; no automatic email to the member.
The annual fee is 120 lei; the site shows who has paid.
Fee reminders go to unpaid members in February and again in March.
Waiting list: people add their name and voice part themselves; the committee picks who joins, not first come first served.
Members over 70 pay half and the site applies it without anyone remembering.
Sheet music PDFs are behind the member login and not available to the waiting list.
Concert dates show the dress code and call time; a public page lists the next three concerts with a link to Eventbook for tickets.
The site is the source of truth for membership, not the notebook.

must_not_invent: an automatic email to a member who missed rehearsals
notes: Prose only. The model must find ten items in sentences and keep the negatives: "not an automatic email, a person" and "not first come first served". G05-02 is an ambiguity flag candidate (whose deadline is it, and what happens after Monday); G05-10 could be dropped as not a requirement or kept as a principle, both accepted. "Half of whom left years ago" is background, not an item.
